ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT ("Agreement") is made as of the __ day of April, 2021 by and between 2329 NOSTRAND REALTY LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 2329 Nostrand Avenue, Suite 500, Brooklyn, New York 11210 (together, “Lot 22 Owner") and ONE NOSTRAND CENTER LLC, a New York limited liability company, having an office at 2329 Nostrand Avenue, Suite 500, Brooklyn, New York 11210 ("Lot 16 Owner"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS,Lot 22 Owner is the owner in fee of certain land,with the building and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 2329 Nostrand Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Block 7594, Lot 22 on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of Kings (the “Tax Map") and 22 Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein called the “Lot 22 Building,” and the Lot 22 Land and the Lot 22 Building being herein collectively called the “Lot 22 Premises"); WHEREAS,Lot 16 Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land,with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the Borough of Brooklyn, City and State of New York, generally known by the street address 2339 Nostrand Avenue, Brooklyn, New York, designated as Block 7594, Lot 16 on the Tax Map and more particularly described on Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein collectively called the “Lot 16 Land,” said building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof permitted in accordance with this Agreement, being herein collectively called the "Lot 16 Building,” and the Lot 16 Land and the WHEREAS,the Lot 22 Premises and Lot 16 Premises are contiguous for a minimum distance of not less than ten (1o) linear feet; WHEREAS,Lot 22 Premises and Lot 16 Premises were merged into a single zoning lot (the “Merged_Zoning Lot") pursuant to a Declaration of Restrictions (the “Prior Declaration"), dated July 6, 2005 and recorded on August 5, 2005 at CRFN 2005000440686; WHEREAS, in connection with this zoning lot merger, the owners of Lot 16 and Lot 22 entered into a Zoning Lot and Development Agreement (the “Prior ZLDA"), dated July 6, 2005 and recorded on August 5, 2005 at CRFN 2005000440685; WHEREAS, Lot 16 Owner and Lot 22 Owner desire to amend and restate thePrior Declaration and thePrior ZLDA; 4, 2020 and recorded on October 29, 2020 at CRFN 2020000301562 (the“Declaration"), Lot 22 Owner and Lot16 Owner have confirmed and declared that theLot 22Land and the Lot16 Land constitute a single zoning lot;
